description: This file implements a health hardware abstraction layer (HAL) for the Android operating system, specifically for the Cuttlefish environment. It provides fake battery and health data for testing or simulation purposes, including methods to retrieve battery charge, current, capacity, and health information.

classes.name: HealthImpl
classes.description: A class implementing the Health interface for the Cuttlefish environment, providing fake health data and battery status.

methods.name: UpdateHealthInfo
methods.description: Populates the HealthInfo structure with simulated battery and health data for testing.

methods.name: getChargeCounterUah
methods.description: Returns a simulated charge counter value in microamp-hours.

methods.name: getCurrentNowMicroamps
methods.description: Returns a simulated current in microamps.

methods.name: getCurrentAverageMicroamps
methods.description: Returns an unsupported operation exception, indicating this method is not implemented.

methods.name: getCapacity
methods.description: Returns a simulated battery capacity percentage.

methods.name: getChargeStatus
methods.description: Returns a simulated battery charging status.

methods.name: getBatteryHealthData
methods.description: Returns simulated detailed battery health data including manufacturing date, usage date, serial number, and health percentage.
